svg.title: What the end-to-end tests run
svg.desc: run.sh drives a Docker Compose project. It talks to Nextcloud, which runs this checkout as a custom app, through occ, WebDAV and the routes of the app; it sets the scenario and the tasks of the Paperless mock, mock_server.py, which Nextcloud calls through the REST API; and it starts Chromium in the image of Playwright, which runs accessibility.mjs, settings.mjs and screenshots.mjs against Nextcloud.
